subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept this postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as a warning-only mitigation for stale gateway imports, or keep stale-gateway handling in update/runtime lifecycle paths such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92241 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99330?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it changes package-install behavior and adds an operator env surface; automation cannot decide whether that is the right product boundary for this failure class.

options.title: Accept postinstall advisory mitigation
options.body: Merge this PR as a low-touch warning path, with maintainers owning the false-positive and install-time probe tradeoff while the canonical issue continues to track deeper recovery choices.

options.title: Keep warning in update/runtime paths
options.body: Decline or pause this PR and concentrate stale-gateway handling in the update CLI, gateway lifecycle, or runtime loader boundaries instead.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller variant that removes or documents the new opt-out env surface and limits service-metadata probing to the maintainer-approved sources.

recommendation.title: Accept postinstall advisory mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as a low-touch warning path, with maintainers owning the false-positive and install-time probe tradeoff while the canonical issue continues to track deeper recovery choices.
